# Backfold

> An in-process Rust and Python library for updating time-series statistics after late arrivals, corrections and retractions. It also provides a native command-line interface and a stdio MCP server for local CSV analysis.

## Choose an entry point

- [Python quickstart](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/backfold#correct-one-reading-in-python) — Install with `python -m pip install backfold`. Create a `MomentsStream`, edit an event with `upsert`, read `summary()` and fork to keep an earlier version.
- [Interactive example](https://pgg898200-ship-it.github.io/backfold/) — Change an earlier sensor reading and inspect the revised Kalman estimate in the browser.
- [API reference](https://pgg898200-ship-it.github.io/backfold/llms-full.txt) — Event keys, method signatures, input shapes and operator-specific costs. Search for `KalmanStream`, `CovarianceStream`, `CusumStream`, `EwmaStream`, `RidgeStream`, `EProcessStream` or `BitemporalMoments`.
- [CLI and MCP setup](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/backfold#give-an-agent-a-csv) — Build the native binary with Cargo. Run `backfold mcp` over stdio. Use `backfold_digest_csv` for candidate windows and `backfold_drill_csv` with the retained CSV for exact rows.
- [Coding-agent skill](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/backfold/blob/main/skills/backfold/SKILL.md) — Task-specific invocation guidance.
- [Runnable recipes](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/backfold/tree/main/examples) — RTS smoothing, PCA, anomaly scoring, bitemporal access and screening across streams.

- [Choosing between related PGG tools](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/backfold/blob/main/docs/PRODUCTS.md) — Compare retrieval, state replication, event subscriptions and cache planning by input contract.

## Integration and evidence

Backfold sits between an event consumer and a statistics query. The application supplies timestamped observations and retains any durable event log. Each supported operator summarizes events in an ordered tree. For fixed dimension a single correction updates O(log T) nodes. Forking shares the tree in O(1). A sequential pass is cheaper to build for one-off aggregation.

- [Architecture](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/backfold/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) — Tree invariants, operator costs and numerical behavior.
- [Benchmark protocol](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/backfold/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.md) — Build costs, edit and query workload, controls and comparison conditions.
- [Recorded benchmark results](https://pgg898200-ship-it.github.io/backfold/results.json) — Machine-readable timings and numerical differences by workload and size.
- [License](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/backfold/blob/main/LICENSE) — Apache-2.0.
